author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie Author Seeking Character Artists for Dark Fantasy Book
content:
Attn Artists:

I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior.

Artists, please link your portfolios.

Criteria:
1) NO AI. Real artists only
2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered
3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W)
4) Canadian Artists preferred
5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT

Contact via replies or DM on Threads.

author: Carolina
title: Seeking 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator
content:
Looking for a 2D & 3D Character Designer / Animator!

I’m looking for a creative talent who can:

* Create flat character illustrations (2D).
* Design and develop 3D characters.
* Animate characters in both 2D and 3D.

Experience in mascot design, character development, and motion animation is a plus.

If you’re interested or know someone who fits, please drop your portfolio or tag them below! ✨
Email : claracarolinawijaya@gmail.com

author: Sega Jenesis
title: Seeking Digital Artists for Custom Pokémon Card Binder Scenes
content:
🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀

I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them!

I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters.

Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway!

Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚

Contact via DM or replies on Threads.
